en: So do you have, like, romantic feelings?{wait}{clear}
Romantic feelings, well...{n}
Feelings like that...{n}
Ah, um... Let me see...{wait}{clear}Low-ranking angels like me do have feelings not so different from humans', but...{wait}{clear}
I see...{wait}{clear}Then have you ever fallen for someone?{wait}{clear}
...I have...{n}
No... never.{n}
Y-yes... I have...{wait}{clear}Long ago... I gave my heart to someone from a world other than this Arcaya...{wait}{clear}
What happened with them?{wait}{clear}
After I left that world and returned to the Heavens, we never met again.{wait}{clear}I have my duty as an angel. That is why I cannot stay in the world below...{wait}{clear}

...I see.{wait}{clear}There was someone I loved for a long time, too... but he went far away... somewhere I can't reach.{wait}{clear}I used to think how great it'd be if I could forget it all. That I loved him, the time we spent together, everything...{wait}{clear}But... I still... just can't forget...{wait}{clear}
That can't be helped...{n}
Someday, surely...{n}
I think that can't be helped.{wait}{clear}No one can forget their feelings that easily. No one...{wait}{clear}
I guess...{wait}{clear}But it hurts, you know? Forever... even though he's never coming back.{wait}{clear}So I hope... someday I can forget...{wait}{clear}
I'm sure that someday... you will be able to forget...{wait}{clear}Time keeps flowing. That may be a cruel thing, but...{wait}{clear}
Yeah...{wait}{clear}I hope... that day comes someday... I really do...{wait}{clear}
Oh! Look, a river!{wait}{clear}
Guess it was just my imagination.{wait}{clear}I know, wanna go for a swim? I'm all sweaty and gross. The heat's made my head all fuzzy...{wait}{clear}
C'mon, let's freshen up!{wait}{clear}
No... never. Even if we have such feelings, we cannot give our hearts to humans...{wait}{clear}
I see... You do seem the serious type, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}But if someone like you ever got serious, you'd fall hard and it'd be a big deal. I'd feel sorry for the guy.{wait}{clear}
Wha...?!{wait}{clear}
Hahaha, I'm kidding, don't be mad!{wait}{clear}
I came to the surface to fulfill my duty. I cannot have such feelings for a human...{wait}{clear}
But what would you do if you fell for someone?{wait}{clear}
If that happened...{n}
Probably... never...{n}
If that happened... I wonder...{wait}{clear}I can't think about it now...{wait}{clear}
Well, maybe that's how it is. But if it ever happens, tell me who you fell for.{wait}{clear}
I'm super curious who you'd fall for.{wait}{clear}
Irene... what do you mean...?{wait}{clear}
I don't think... that will probably ever happen.{wait}{clear}
You think so?{wait}{clear}I get the feeling you'd fall head over heels, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. You seem kinda naive about the world.{wait}{clear}Well, just don't get hooked by some bad guy.{wait}{clear}
B-bad guy?! Irene... what do you mean...?{wait}{clear}
No. I will never have such feelings.{wait}{clear}Angels work for the sake of a greater love.{wait}{clear}
Hmm...{wait}{clear}But yeah... it'd be hard for angels to do their job if they had the same feelings as humans.{wait}{clear}Falling for someone isn't all pretty and pure, after all.{wait}{clear}
It's really selfish, and it has its ugly side too. Well, that's got nothing to do with an angel.{wait}{clear}
Oh! Look, look! A river.{wait}{clear}
Huh... guess it was just my imagination.{wait}{clear}I know, wanna go for a swim? I'm all sweaty and gross.{wait}{clear}
...Nobody's looking, right? C'mon, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, you too!{wait}{clear}
Yes, we are... more or less...{wait}{clear}
Hmm.{wait}{clear}So could you fall for a human too?{wait}{clear}
That's...{n}
No, never.{n}
That's... um...{wait}{clear}
Why are you mumbling?{wait}{clear}Oh, there IS someone? A girl you like!{wait}{clear}
No, there's no one like that...{wait}{clear}
You don't have to look so flustered, do you?{wait}{clear}

Well, whatever. It's your business who you like.{wait}{clear}But I'm kinda relieved. You're so serious and you hardly ever show your feelings...{wait}{clear}I was kinda curious what you thought about humans.{wait}{clear}
You're not all that different from humans, huh.{wait}{clear}
No, never.{wait}{clear}
Ooh, you said it flat out.{wait}{clear}
Really?{wait}{clear}
You sound awfully sure. Is that really true? Seems kinda fishy to me.{wait}{clear}
What's fishy about it?{wait}{clear}
Oh, nothing, just a hunch.{wait}{clear}
Hey, even if you fall for me, a guy like you doesn't stand a chance, okay?{wait}{clear}I've gotta say it up front or you'll get the wrong idea.{wait}{clear}
Don't worry, that won't happen.{wait}{clear}
You didn't have to say it so bluntly!{wait}{clear}
Geez, this guy has no eye for girls at all... There's no girl as cute and sweet-natured as me.{wait}{clear}
Huh...?{wait}{clear}
What's with that face?{wait}{clear}If you've got a complaint, say it. Geez...{wait}{clear}
So have you ever fallen for a human girl?{wait}{clear}
I-I have...{n}
I haven't.{n}
Y-yes, I... I have... In the first world below I ever descended to...{wait}{clear}Though since I left that world, we have never met again...{wait}{clear}
Really...{wait}{clear}That's a surprise. I never thought you had a past like that, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Oh, was it bad of me to ask?{wait}{clear}
No. Please don't worry about it.{wait}{clear}

Good.{wait}{clear}But I bet you've been through a lot of things.{wait}{clear}You're always so serious and never show your feelings, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so I wondered what you thought about humans, but...{wait}{clear}
I'm kinda relieved.{wait}{clear}
Not until now, no.{wait}{clear}
Hmm. I see.{wait}{clear}But who knows from here on, right? So how about it?{wait}{clear}
I mean, what do you think of the girls in this world? You're so dense.{wait}{clear}
I don't really know...{n}
I think they're nice...{n}
I don't really know...{wait}{clear}

Figures you'd say that.{wait}{clear}Well, it's up to you who you think what about, but how about showing your feelings a little more?{wait}{clear}Talking to you makes ME nervous. I wonder if you even get how people feel.{wait}{clear}Well, maybe there's no point in saying it.{wait}{clear}
I think they are all lovely, good people.{wait}{clear}
What's that? That's your honest answer?{wait}{clear}
Well, I can't tell if you're just too nice or what, but try looking at people as individuals a bit more.{wait}{clear}For example, how do I look to you?{wait}{clear}
You may have a sharp tongue, Irene, but you have a very warm heart.{wait}{clear}
You really think so? You're not just buttering me up?{wait}{clear}

Of course not. I believe everyone has good points and bad points.{wait}{clear}It's easy to pick at someone's faults. But I don't think that means you understand them.{wait}{clear}Because I believe the good in a person is who they truly are.{wait}{clear}
Hmm, how noble. So that's how angels think.{wait}{clear}Well, at least I get your way of thinking a little better now. Not that I buy every single bit of it.{wait}{clear}
Oh! Look, look! A river!{wait}{clear}
Huh... guess it was just my imagination.{wait}{clear}I know, maybe I'll go for a swim. I'm all sweaty and gross.{wait}{clear}
Um...{wait}{clear}
.........{wait}{clear}Ah!!{wait}{clear}Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄! How long are you gonna hang around? Get lost already!!{wait}{clear}Geez... can't let my guard down for a second...!!!{wait}{clear}
The Guild's Grand Lodge is here in the city of Alkmaar.{wait}{clear}
Um, I'm sorry, Irene. I don't really understand what the Guild or the Grand Lodge are...{wait}{clear}
Huh? You don't even know that, ＄＄＄＄＄＄? You really need to study this world more.{wait}{clear}
Yes... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
Okay? I'll explain, so listen carefully.{wait}{clear}
The Guild is the association of sorcerers.{wait}{clear}Ordinary people hate the power we sorcerers have...{wait}{clear}So they say the Guild was formed to protect ourselves.{wait}{clear}

And a lodge is sort of a home for the Guild's sorcerers. There are lots of lodges, especially here in the Six Kingdoms.{wait}{clear}Of those, the Grand Lodge is where the Grand Master lives, the one at the top of all the Guild's masters.{wait}{clear}Got it?{wait}{clear}
Yes, I understand.{n}
I don't get it at all.{n}
I don't understand.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄! Just now you were nodding along going "I see"! And now you say THAT?!{wait}{clear}
Listen, I'll explain it one more time, so pay attention!!{wait}{clear}
Yes, thank you very much.{wait}{clear}
Anyway, the current Grand Master was Grandpa's best friend.{wait}{clear}Since we came all this way, maybe I'll drop by... I might hear something useful.{wait}{clear}
Why not go and see?{n}
Either way is fine.{n}
Yes, since we're here, why not go and see?{wait}{clear}As you said, Irene, you might hear something new.{wait}{clear}
I guess...{wait}{clear}But... I'll do it some other time! If I just show up out of nowhere, I won't know what to say.{wait}{clear}Come on, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, let's hurry on.{wait}{clear}
Y-yes...{wait}{clear}
I think either way is fine. I'll leave it up to you, Irene.{wait}{clear}
Hmm...{wait}{clear}Nah, I'll skip it. It'd be awkward to just show up out of nowhere.{wait}{clear}Come on, let's hurry on, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Did you know the Guild's Grand Lodge is here in the town of Alkmaar?{wait}{clear}
The Grand Lodge?{wait}{clear}
